info.scr_teacher: 劉育成,陳秋宏,陳瑞霖,黃錦煌,蔡鈺鼎
info.scr_teacher_eng: Yu-ting Tsai,Chiu-Hung Chen,Reh-Lin Chen,Jin-Huang Huang,Yu-ting Tsai

description.describe_ch: 碩士論文為訓練學生執行研究與解決問題的能力，學生針對研究問題進行研究和設計，並撰寫研究論文。論文內容需含導論、文獻回顧、方法、研究結果、結論和參考文獻。
description.describe_eh: The goal of master thesis intends to achieve the training of executing the project solving problems and writing ability of thesis. The thesis must include introduction, review, method, results, conclusions and reference.

targets.describe_ch: 能用專業定理應用於碩士論文研究中，執行與驗證各項專業定理，其中包括資料的蒐集、維護、管理與理論的測試。
targets.describe_en: When can apply to study in master's thesis the theorem, carry out and verify every theorem, including the collection, maintenance, test of management and theory of the materials.

targets.describe_ch: 具備電聲專業領域蒐集資料、規範問題、加以分析驗證、創新思考等能力，並應用於碩士論文研究中
targets.describe_en: Electro-acoustic field data collection, standardization, analysis and validation, innovative thinking ability, and applied to the master's thesis research.

targets.describe_ch: 能整合電聲工程領域相關知識進行分析、設計及獨立解決問題之能力，並應用於碩士論文研究中
targets.describe_en: Consolidation analysis of relevant knowledge in the field of electro-acoustic engineering, design and ability to solve problems independently, and applied to the master's thesis research.

targets.describe_ch: 碩士論文研究過程，恪遵專業倫理。
targets.describe_en: In the research process of master's thesis, compliance with professional ethics.
